title: Amaranthus: modeled ₹511/qtl left, Parappanangadi → Madhavapuram
summary: January 2021: reported amaranthus prices at Parappanangadi and Madhavapuram imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 92% of 25 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹511 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 68 same-variety market pairs screened for amaranthus in January 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Madhavapuram report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2021
scenes.caption: Parappanangadi (Kerala) and Madhavapuram (Kerala) both reported amaranthus prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 25 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Parappanangadi reported a median ₹2,100 per quintal. Madhavapuram reported a median ₹3,000 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹900/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹900 per quintal, and Madhavapuram was dearer on 96% of days.

scenes.headline: 261 km by road
scenes.caption: 261 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~4 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹56/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹574 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹409 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Madhavapuram report, the rule selects 21 of 23 modeled shipping days. 19 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹511 per quintal (₹349 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Amaranthus route from Parappanangadi to Madhavapuram was positive on 92% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹51,100, or ₹34,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to amaranthus
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹56/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Amaranthus route from Parappanangadi to Madhavapuram was positive on 92% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹51,100, or ₹34,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
